Overview Features Compatibility Documentation FAQ

Overview

What it is. BlockLimiter caps block counts per chunk so dense player-built structures cannot dominate load and persistence cost. Limits are configured per block type.

Who it's for. Server admins whose TPS drops come from entity counts, redstone machines or dense player-built structures.

Compatibility. Platforms: Bukkit, Spigot. Folia support is declared in the repository. Check the details below before you deploy.

What it covers

  • ✓ Per-chunk block limits
  • ✓ Per-block-type configuration
  • ✓ Folia support
